$comment: The cloud every public build of Zenith talks to: the Firebase web config of the production project and its App Check site key. Neither is a secret: both end up in every page the web app serves. scripts/release-cloud.mjs builds releases with them (the Pages site, the desktop installers) and fails a release build that lacks them. A build from source without that script, such as `pnpm build` or the dev server, has the cloud off. cloud/README.md, "Public builds", says how to change a value.
